name: @playliquid/target-profiles
description: PlayLiquid GameOS target/profile contract layer (PL-008). The frozen target taxonomy (web, spark, windows, macos, linux, android, ios, steamdeck, xr, dedicated-server, console — R12), typed per-target capability descriptors, runtime policy bindings (runtime-contracts vocabulary), engine-binding compatibility declarations, content-addressed immutable target profile records with seal/verify discipline, and pure validators (target/engine compatibility, profile digest integrity, evaluation-suite references). Spark carries its 9:16 mobile-first minimal-critical-boot properties as a distinct typed record — a target profile, never a second content model (lock rule 16). Pure types and pure functions only: no IO, no engine SDKs.
